versions.content: If KeyM_Update() is called and KeyMCryptoKeyHandlerUpda- teEnabled is set to FALSE and keyNameLength is greater than 0, the crypto key sub- module shall search for the key name configured in KeyMCryptoKey/KeyMCryptoKey Name. If the key name is not found, the function shall return KEYM_E_PARAMETER_ MISMATCH. If found, the function shall trigger the key update operation.

snippets.why: defines KeyM_Update behavior when handler disabled
